### ICON partners with Anthropic to integrate Claude AI in clinical trials


ICON has partnered with Anthropic to integrate Claude's frontier AI capabilities into the clinical trial lifecycle through its secure Orbis platform, advancing study planning, trial intelligence and protocol optimisation.
